seo.metaTitle: White-Label Business Email for Partners | Hostopia
seo.metaDescription: Deliver secure, professional business email under your brand. Hostopia's white-label email platform supports domain-based and consumer email with expert migrations.

hero.headline: Secure, Professional Email — Delivered Under Your Brand
hero.description: Email is mission-critical infrastructure. Every business needs it, every customer expects it, and the provider who delivers it becomes the anchor of that relationship. Hostopia's white-label Business Email gives you an enterprise-grade platform to resell under your brand — domain-based, consumer, or both — with expert migrations and 24/7 end-user support included.

items.title: Professional email on their own domain
items.body: Business email tied to the customer's own domain builds credibility and trust with every message sent — the difference between being taken seriously and being filtered to spam. Hostopia activates domain-based email immediately after domain registration, so new customers go from "I just bought my domain" to "I'm sending email from my new address" in minutes, not days. For SMB owners, it's the single most visible upgrade from a generic Gmail account. For partners, it's the single highest-attach product in the portfolio.

items.title: Ad-free, feature-rich branded webmail
items.body: Modern webmail with calendars, contacts, tasks, traffic alerts, and online storage — all under your brand, all with zero advertising. Your customers get the productivity experience they expect from consumer tools, without having their inbox monetized by a competing service. Shared calendars and contact lists turn email into a lightweight collaboration platform for small teams, and the clean, ad-free interface reinforces the premium feel of being on your platform rather than a free tier somewhere else.

items.title: Enterprise-grade security built in by default
items.body: Most SMBs never configure their own spam filters or anti-virus rules — they just suffer the consequences. Hostopia's platform ships with enterprise-grade anti-virus protection, configurable spam filtering, trusted and blocked sender lists, and optional backup included. Security happens quietly in the background, which means fewer "I got a virus from email" support tickets and more customers who trust your platform to protect them automatically.

items.title: Access anywhere, on any device
items.body: Full IMAP, POP, and SMTP support means your customers' email works everywhere they work — Outlook on the desktop, Apple Mail on a Mac, mobile clients on iOS and Android, or clean browser-based webmail from anywhere. No workflow to change, no forced migration to a new client. Owners set up once and move seamlessly between devices. Teams stay synchronized. And you deliver the flexibility expected of modern email without building the infrastructure yourself.

image.alt: Email on phone and laptop anywhere

items.title: Migrate from legacy platforms without losing a message
items.body: Moving email providers is the single scariest change an SMB ever makes — one lost message can end a customer relationship. Hostopia's proprietary migration tools and experienced migrations team move users from legacy platforms with zero downtime and zero data loss, across mailboxes of any size. For partners, it's the difference between winning the migration conversation and losing it. For customers, it's the difference between "we're switching providers" and "we're switching providers, and nothing broke."

features.heading: A Complete Email Platform — Packaged Your Way
features.intro: Hostopia handles the infrastructure, security, and support. You control the packaging, pricing, and customer experience — and position yourself as the email provider every SMB relies on every day.

cards.title: Flexible Email Tiers
cards.body: Domain-based business email, consumer email, or both. Storage tiers at 3 GB, 6 GB, 9 GB, and 12 GB — so you can tailor plans, upsell premium options, and monetize overages.

cards.title: Enterprise-Grade Security
cards.body: Built-in anti-virus, configurable spam filtering, trusted and blocked sender lists, and optional backup. Security SMBs need but rarely configure on their own — delivered by default.

cards.title: Built-In Productivity Tools
cards.body: Shared calendars, contacts, tasks, and traffic alerts keep SMB teams synchronized — turning email into a lightweight collaboration platform with no additional apps required.

cards.title: Expert Email Migration
cards.body: Proprietary migration tools and an experienced migrations team move users from legacy platforms with zero downtime, zero data loss, and zero customer churn.

cards.title: 24/7 End-User Support
cards.body: Hostopia's support team handles end-user email issues around the clock under your brand — reducing your support overhead without compromising the customer experience.

cards.title: Universal Client Support
cards.body: Full IMAP, POP, and SMTP compatibility with Outlook, Apple Mail, mobile clients, and webmail. Works everywhere SMBs already work, on every device they already own.

partnerAdvantage.heading: The Anchor Product That Holds Your Portfolio Together
partnerAdvantage.intro: Email is the highest-usage digital product in your stack. The partner who delivers it becomes the partner SMBs depend on every day — and the one they'll never switch away from casually.

items.title: Highest-usage, highest-retention product in the stack
items.body: SMBs check email dozens of times a day. That frequency creates the deepest possible engagement — and the strongest retention hook of any product in your portfolio.

items.title: Natural attach with domains and hosting
items.body: Every domain registration is an email opportunity. Every website deployment is a professional email upgrade. Email bundles naturally with your core services and boosts attach across the board.

items.title: Zero-downtime migrations win competitive takeovers
items.body: Hostopia's migration capability turns "we can move you" from a sales promise into a proven, no-risk outcome. You win more competitive deals and migrate bigger books of business without customer disruption.

items.title: Enterprise platform, SMB pricing
items.body: The same infrastructure that powers enterprise email — delivered at pricing that works for SMBs and margins that work for you. No platform to build, no operations to staff.
